# sailpoint_application (Resource)

Resource for SailPoint Application (source app). Applications represent individual apps within a SailPoint source for password management and access request workflows. This resource uses the experimental `/source-apps/v1` API (`X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sailpoint_application" "example" {
  name        = "Example Application"
  description = "An application within a SailPoint source"

  match_all_accounts = false
  enabled            = true

  account_source = {
    id   = "REPLACE_WITH_SOURCE_ID"
    type = "SOURCE"
  }

  owner = {
    type = "IDENTITY"
    id   = "REPLACE_WITH_OWNER_IDENTITY_ID"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_source` (Attributes) The SailPoint source that owns this application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account_source))
- `name` (String) The name of the application.

### Optional

- `app_center_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the application is visible in the request center.
- `description` (String) The description of the application.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the application is enabled.
- `match_all_accounts` (Boolean) Whether the application matches all accounts on the backing source.
- `owner` (Attributes) The owner of the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `provision_request_enabled` (Boolean) Whether access requests are enabled for this application.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_app_id` (String) The deprecated cloud application identifier.
- `created` (String) When the application was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the application.
- `modified` (String) When the application was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--account_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `account_source`

Required:

- `id` (String) The ID of the backing SailPoint source.

Optional:

- `type` (String) The source reference type. Typically `SOURCE`.

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The name of the backing source.
- `password_policies` (Attributes List) Password policies associated with the backing source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account_source--password_policies))
- `use_for_password_management` (Boolean) Whether the backing source is used for password management.

<a id="nestedatt--account_source--password_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `account_source.password_policies`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)



<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Required:

- `id` (String) The owner ID.
- `type` (String) The owner type. Must be `IDENTITY`.

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The owner name. Resolved by the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Import an existing application by its ID.
terraform import sailpoint_application.example "REPLACE_WITH_APPLICATION_ID"
```
